entries.text_de:
Oxford Bodley Junius 65, copirt aus G.

Oxford All souls’ College 41, früher Luttrell, Ende 16. Jhs., Lateinischer Theil der Edition Ld’s wörtlich copirt: Ine Af Ew As Em Atr Cn Wl ECf.

Oxford Queen’s College 212, 17. Jh., ‘a. 1664 Barlow ex dono Houghton’ gehörig, aus Ld, der vorn citirt wird: Ine Af AGu Ew EGu As Em Eg Atr Duns Cn Wl ECf. Mit juristischen Noten aus Rechtsbüchern 13. Jahrhunderts.
entries.text_en:
Oxford, Bodley Junius 65, copied from G.

Oxford, All Souls’ College 41, formerly Luttrell’s, end of the 16th century, the Latin part of Ld’s edition copied word for word: Ine Af Ew As Em Atr Cn Wl ECf.

Oxford, Queen’s College 212, 17th century, belonging ‘a. 1664 Barlow ex dono Houghton’, from Ld, who is cited at the front: Ine Af AGu Ew EGu As Em Eg Atr Duns Cn Wl ECf. With legal notes from law books of the 13th century.

transcription.doubts: 'Oxford' is a place heading rather than a siglum. Letter-spacing within these lines is uneven; I marked Bodley, All souls’, Queen’s. '17. Jh.' printed with a heavy stop after 17.
